Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence

Class PartidaDAO

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence.PartidaDAO
public class PartidaDAO extends Object
The PartidaDAO class is responsible for managing CRUD operations for the PartidaDTO class. It uses a custom data structure, MyLinkedList, to store and manipulate the list of games. Main methods: - create(PartidaDTO): Creates a new game and adds it to the list of games. - update(String, PartidaDTO): Updates the data of an existing game identified by its name. - delete(String): Removes a game from the list based on its name. - findOne(String): Searches for and retrieves a specific game by its name. - crerEquipoEnPartida(String, EquipoDTO): Adds a team to a specific game. - borrarEquipoEnPartida(String, String): Removes a team from a game based on its name and team color. - updateEquipoEnPartida(String, String, EquipoDTO): Updates a team within a game based on its color. - findOneEquipo(String, String): Searches for and retrieves a specific team within a game by its team color.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio
